answer: Farming becomes a lagoon bet on surviving 74 epochs of grading, and every basalt settlement recomputes the vertex schedule, so an attacker who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is thus worth nothing for 14 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 74 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 35 dollars per alias. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
